subject: Gemini 4 Neon 🧠, OpenAI Chip Model +14% PPA 🔧, Devin Bots 🤖
notes: No funding rounds, acquisitions, IPOs or funds in this issue. Body text is split across lines at link boundaries, so quotes are taken from single lines.

stories.headline: Google DeepMind releases Gemini 4 Neon at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens
stories.description: Gemini 4 Neon model, between cheaper Hydrogen and more powerful Carbon

facts.text: Gemini 4 Neon input price: $3 per million input tokens
Gemini 4 Neon output price: $15 per million output tokens
Gemini 4 Neon ranks #3 on the Intelligence Index
facts.quote: Google DeepMind ships Gemini 4 Neon, ranking #3 on the Intelligence Index

facts.text: Positioned between the cheaper Hydrogen and the more powerful Carbon; described as faster and cheaper per task
facts.quote: , a new model sitting between the cheaper Hydrogen and the more powerful Carbon. Think of it as the sweet spot: near-Carbon reasoning quality, but faster and cheaper per task.

facts.text: 1M token context window shared across input, thinking and output
facts.quote: shared across input, thinking, and output, so you can feed it entire codebases or long documents

facts.text: Four thinking levels (low, medium, high, xhigh) that control spend
facts.quote: Four thinking levels: low, medium, high, and xhigh, so you control how hard it thinks and what you spend

facts.text: Available via the Gemini API, AI Studio and Android Studio
facts.quote: You can use it right now via the Gemini API, AI Studio, and Android Studio with model ID

stories.headline: OpenAI's chip design models find up to 14% PPA improvement on AMD's flagship GPU
stories.quote: OpenAI's chip design model delivers 14% hardware gains on AMD's GPU
stories.description: AI models that rewrite chip circuit code

facts.text: AMD has included some of the changes in a recent design sent for manufacturing; roughly a year of progress in under five months
facts.quote: That's roughly a year of progress achieved in less than five months. And these weren't fresh designs either. AMD has already included some changes in a recent design sent for manufacturing, with others added to production files for future versions.

facts.text: OpenAI ran the same approach on Jalapeño, its own custom chip, with gains confirmed on real silicon
facts.quote: , its own custom chip built to run AI models, with gains confirmed on real silicon.

facts.text: GPT-Synopsys is a new model trained to use Synopsys EDA tools
facts.quote: : a new model trained to use Synopsys EDA tools the way expert chip designers do.
